title: OpenSensor.Space
description: Continuous time-series environmental and weather readings from an IoT monitoring network in the Cairo/Nile Delta region of Egypt, collected via Raspberry Pi devices with Enviro+ sensors. Each record includes temperature, pressure, humidity, gas concentrations (oxidised, reducing, NH3), ambient light, and particulate matter at multiple size fractions (PM1, PM2.5, PM10), partitioned by station and date. A companion asset provides a geospatial suitability analysis for air quality monitoring station placement.
